[[Morgriff's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Morgriff Shadestone]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Grenth's Footprint]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 10%)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +10

==Skin==
This item shares the same skin as the [[Dark Spore Staff]].
